why: THE FALSE POSITIVE ON THE AUTHOR, and it is not hypothetical: rebar's own script is `node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check .`, written that way because `npx prettier` is not the same command on both systems of the CI matrix. A rule that matched a command STARTING with `prettier`, or that split on whitespace and read the first token, would have failed the repository that ships the rule — the third time this project would have been caught demanding a spelling instead of a practice, after `NOMES_TYPECHECK` and the shadcn `tailwind-merge`. The `pass` side is that script; the `fail` side is the same invocation through the same path with `--write`, so the two trees differ in one flag and the case can only go green if what is being read is the MODE and not the shape of the call.

commits.mensagem: prettier chamado pelo caminho do node_modules
